description: This Java class 'DrugsByNameComparator' implements Comparator<Drug> to compare drug names while ignoring numericals and non-letter characters, used for sorting drugs in the openmrs-core project.

classes.name: DrugsByNameComparator
classes.description: A utility comparator class for sorting Drug objects by their names, ignoring numericals and special characters.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Overrides Comparator.compare to compare two Drug objects based on their sanitized names.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals
methods.description: Compares two drugs' names after removing all non-letter characters; returns comparison result ignoring case.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes all characters except a-z and A-Z from a string, used for sanitizing drug names.
